A deterministic 831-pair matching leaves exactly one 0-cell and 64 dimension-4 cells; an exhaustive acyclic topological sort checks all 6,606 Hasse incidences. The resulting integral wedge concentration justifies extracting the rational H4 character from exact signed simplicial Lefschetz sums for all 12 automorphisms. Character inner products yield (3,7,10,8,4,11), with total 64 dimensions and three G-invariants. Quotient homology follows from rational exactness of finite-group averaging after equivariant subdivision. The included fresh self-contained code reconstructs every finite assertion.

value.rationale: The triangular prism is the Morse complex of the first iterated triangle and has a natural full S3×C2 automorphism action. The already known rank 64 and wedge type do not distinguish its character or quotient. Six exact traces and an irreducible splitting, notably layer-swap eigenspace ranks 30 and 34 and three-dimensional invariant H4, solve a natural equivariant classification beyond any ordinary Betti number. The result is a complete invariant under the full graph symmetry, not an arbitrary subfamily or unsupported tiny numerical gain.
